name: SaaSBaba

conditions: Submission is free but SaaSBaba reportedly asks for a backlink to saasbaba.com on your site as collaboration
Free submissions sit in a long queue (third-party sources cite 45-60 days, and one guide claims 180+ days)
A paid skip-the-queue option (~$9-19, sources disagree) promises listing within 24 hours
requirements: Focused on MicroSaaS and AI/generative-AI products
Submission is a question-based form ('answer a few questions about your product')
Site is JavaScript-rendered — the homepage returns an empty body to plain HTTP fetchers
preparation: Product name, URL, description, and category
Willingness to add a SaaSBaba backlink/badge to your site
Decision on whether to pay the queue-skip fee
workflow: Find the 'Add Your App' / submit section — the historically cited submit URL https://saasbaba.com/add-ai-tool/ returned 404 during research
Either wait out the free queue or pay the small fee for 24-hour listing
watchFor: Conflicting third-party numbers: queue-skip fee quoted at both $9 and $19, queue at 45-60 vs 180+ days — verify on the live site
The reciprocal-backlink request makes the 'free' listing a link exchange
The documented submit URL (add-ai-tool) is dead — the submission path may have moved or been removed
Very low domain authority per third-party profiles — modest SEO value
countsAsLive: The product appears as a public listing on saasbaba.com's tool directory
unknowns: Current working submission URL and form fields
Whether the backlink request is mandatory or optional
Actual queue length and skip-fee amount
Whether listings are dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
